name: sensor_container_geometry
description: For placing an object into a basket, bowl or other roughly horizontal open container, use this instead of repeated single-pixel back_project calls and manual rim averaging. In ONE call select 4-8 pixels spread around the visible INNER RIM (not cloth wall/floor); returns opening center XY, rim height, EEF offset and flags mixed depth. Pixels are [row,col] in the calibrated 1024x1024 image by default; never use the mirrored policy image. Only after grasping, optionally add a clearly visible HELD OBJECT bottom pixel (not the container center or floor) to measure its height and alignment relative to the opening. Reuse measured geometry for a stationary container. This only measures caller-selected surfaces; it does not identify objects, execute motion or judge task success.

rim_points.description: [row,col] points spread around the inner rim; order is arbitrary. Do not select visible interior wall as the center.

object_bottom_point.description: Optional bottom of the HELD OBJECT in the SAME frame. Omit before grasping or when occluded; not a container/floor point.

image_size.description: [height,width] of the image used to select pixels.
